definitions.explanation: Currently living in a particular place. Used as a suffix after a place name to indicate residence. More formal than {住|す}んでいる.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}{在住|ざいじゅう}の{方|かた}が{対象|たいしょう}です。
examples.english: This is for people residing in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}の{日本人|にほんじん}にインタビューした。
examples.english: We interviewed Japanese people living overseas.

examples.japanese: {大阪|おおさか}{在住|ざいじゅう}{歴|れき}{二十|にじゅう}{年|ねん}のアメリカ{人|じん}が{地元|じもと}のグルメを{紹介|しょうかい}している。
examples.english: An American who has lived in Osaka for twenty years is introducing local cuisine.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used as a suffix after a place name: {東京|とうきょう}{在住|ざいじゅう}, {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}, ニューヨーク{在住|ざいじゅう}. Functions as a noun modifier (の) or predicate. Common in profiles, biographical descriptions, and eligibility criteria.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東京|とうきょう}{在住|ざいじゅう}: residing in Tokyo
- {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}: living overseas
- {都内|とない}{在住|ざいじゅう}: residing in metropolitan Tokyo
- ～{在住|ざいじゅう}{歴|れき}: years of residence in ~
